_comment: Observable glow feel (see include/Glimmer.h). An unobserved observable glows warm + breathes when the player is within interact_reach of its box (a 'come look' Souls-style prompt); once observed it keeps a muted persistent glow, a touch brighter while in reach. All values are tunable -- edit + relaunch (dev reads assets from the source tree). Mirrors config/head_marker.json.
